A 2026 exchange filing by Dongfeng Automobile confirms it is wholly owned by Dongfeng Motor Co., Ltd., which is itself owned 50:50 by Dongfeng Motor Group Company Limited and Nissan (China) Investment Co., Ltd. Zhengzhou Nissan therefore must not be described as directly 50:50 owned by Nissan and Dongfeng and inherits no parent ticker.
